name: Compyle
description_en:
Compyle is a product in the AI coding category. Its directory profile covers Natural Language to Code, Context-Aware Code, AI Copilot, Multi Programming Languages, Code Completion, Collaboration Tools, Version Control.

Deployment is listed as Browser Based (Cloud). The listed organization sizes are Medium Business Small Business Individuals. API support is listed as Available. Support channels are listed as Online.

The directory's pricing snapshot states: Free Trial Not Available Offers Free-forever plan.. This is a dated third-party reference; current amounts, billing periods, trial conditions and regional availability require an official pricing check.

Typical evaluation tasks associated with these feature labels include: suggest code while it is being written; support shared work and communication between participants; track changes to files and support revision workflows. These are workflow suggestions based on the reported capabilities, rather than evidence of actual customer adoption.

资料所列运行方式为浏览器访问（云服务）。资料所列适用组织规模为中型企业 小型企业 个人用户。API 支持情况为提供。资料所列支持方式为在线支持。

根据这些功能，可重点评估以下任务：在编写过程中提供代码补全建议；支持多人共同工作和沟通；跟踪文件变更并支持版本修订流程。这些是基于功能的使用场景建议，不能当作实际客户采用的证据。
